description: Realistic gh 2.101.0 HTTP-failure shapes for deriveGhHttpStatus / classifyInaccessibleIssueLookup coverage (kurone-kito/idd-skill#3335). Built from gh's own format strings (`%s (HTTP %d)`, a bare `HTTP %d` printed through `gh: %s`, `HTTP %d: %s (%s)`, and `HTTP %d (%s)`) plus a REST JSON error body -- not live-captured API responses.

samlEnforcement403.stderr: gh: Resource protected by organization SAML enforcement. You must grant your OAuth token access to this organization. (HTTP 403)

integration403.stderr: gh: Resource not accessible by integration (HTTP 403)

secondaryRateLimit403.stderr: gh: You have exceeded a secondary rate limit. Please wait a few minutes before you try again (HTTP 403)
